summary: Prevent stale governance preflight cache for sqlite tickets

delivery.outcome: Prevent reuse of stale governance preflight results for unbound comparison bases and mutable SQLite/external ticket inputs. Preserve safe explicit-base file-ticket caching; join material patch0.20.128 through exact-head protected review, merge and immutable publication.
nonGoals: Change the secret scanner, ownership algorithms, local file-URL grouping, product consumers, dependencies, credentials or protected delivery policy.
Hash only SQLite main-file bytes as proof of current WAL state, or treat a cache result as execution/review authority.

architecture.decision: Decline a preflight cache key when comparison base is not bound or ticket input depends on SQLite, an external snapshot/pin, or unknown/unreadable clone storage mode. Run the existing uncached reader and all its integrity/subject checks. Preserve ordinary explicit-base file-ticket caching and byte-identical source/bundle implementation. New tests use real, freshly owned Git/SQLite fixtures including WAL and stale pinned snapshots. No public CLI flags or signatures change.
architecture.rollback: Revert the bounded material patch through protected delivery; retain unknown and foreign data.

validation.evidence: Actual SQLite status changes, configured storage and WAL cannot return an old cached PASS; mutated snapshots rerun digest verification.
Unbound-base or unknown storage cannot reuse old results; explicit file-ticket cache hits, CI/no-cache and output boundaries remain correct.
Normal hooks, native23/root and exact-head Linux/Windows/OneDev pass; protected independent review controls merge and native immutable128 publication.
